text_en: This is the list of the descendants of Adam. When God created humankind, he made them in the likeness of God.
text_cn: 以下是亚当后裔的族谱：当天主造人的时候，是按天主的肖像造的，

text_en: Male and female he created them, and he blessed them and named them “Humankind” when they were created.
text_cn: 造了一男一女，且在造他们的那一天，祝福了他们，称他们为“人”。

text_en: When Adam had lived one hundred thirty years, he became the father of a son in his likeness, according to his image, and named him Seth.
text_cn: 亚当一百三十岁时，生了一个儿子，也像自己的模样和肖像，给他起名叫舍特。

text_en: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years; and he had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 亚当生舍特后，还活了八百年，生了其他的儿女。

text_en: Thus all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years; and he died.
text_cn: 亚当共活了九百三十岁死了。

text_en: When Seth had lived one hundred five years, he became the father of Enosh.
text_cn: 舍特一百零五岁时，生了厄诺士。

text_en: Seth lived after the birth of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 舍特生厄诺士后，还活了八百零七年，生了其他的儿女。

text_en: Thus all the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years; and he died.
text_cn: 舍特共活了九百一十二岁死了。

text_en: When Enosh had lived ninety years, he became the father of Kenan.
text_cn: 厄诺士九十岁时生了刻南。

text_en: Enosh lived after the birth of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 厄诺士生刻南后，还活了八百一十五年，生了其他的儿女。

text_en: Thus all the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years; and he died.
text_cn: 厄诺士共活了九百零五岁死了。

text_en: When Kenan had lived seventy years, he became the father of Mahalalel.
text_cn: 刻南七十岁时，生了玛拉肋耳。

text_en: Kenan lived after the birth of Mahalalel eight hundred and forty years, and had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 刻南生玛拉肋耳后，还活了八百四十年，生了其他的儿女。

text_en: Thus all the days of Kenan were nine hundred and ten years; and he died.
text_cn: 刻南共活了九百一十岁死了。

text_en: When Mahalalel had lived sixty-five years, he became the father of Jared.
text_cn: 玛拉肋耳六十五岁时，生了耶勒得。

text_en: Mahalalel lived after the birth of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 玛拉肋耳生耶勒得后，还活了八百三十年，生了其他的儿女。

text_en: Thus all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years; and he died.
text_cn: 玛拉肋耳共活了八百九十五岁死了。

text_en: When Jared had lived one hundred sixty-two years he became the father of Enoch.
text_cn: 耶勒得一百六十二岁时，生了哈诺客。

text_en: Jared lived after the birth of Enoch eight hundred years, and had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 耶勒得生哈诺客后。还活了八百年，生了其他的儿女。

text_en: Thus all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years; and he died.
text_cn: 耶勒得共活了九百六十二岁死了。

text_en: When Enoch had lived sixty-five years, he became the father of Methuselah.
text_cn: 哈诺客六十五岁时，生了默突舍拉。

text_en: Enoch walked with God after the birth of Methuselah three hundred years, and had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 哈诺客常与天主往来。哈诺客生默突舍拉后，还活了三百年，生了其他的儿女。

text_en: Thus all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.
text_cn: 哈诺客共活了三百六十五岁。

text_en: Enoch walked with God; then he was no more, because God took him.
text_cn: 哈诺客时与天主往来，然后就不见了，因为天主将他提去。

text_en: When Methuselah had lived one hundred eighty-seven years, he became the father of Lamech.
text_cn: 默突舍拉一百八十七岁时，生了拉默客。

text_en: Methuselah lived after the birth of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 默突舍拉生了拉默客后，还活了七百八十二年，生了其他的儿女。

text_en: Thus all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years; and he died.
text_cn: 默突舍拉共活了九百六十九岁死了。

text_en: When Lamech had lived one hundred eighty-two years, he became the father of a son;
text_cn: 拉默客一百八十二岁时，生了一个儿子，

text_en: he named him Noah, saying, “Out of the ground that the Lord has cursed this one shall bring us relief from our work and from the toil of our hands. ”
text_cn: 给他起名叫诺厄说：“这孩子要使我们在上主诅咒的地上，在我们做的工作和劳苦上，获得欣慰！”

text_en: Lamech lived after the birth of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 拉默客生诺厄后，还活了五百九十五年，生了其他的儿女。

text_en: Thus all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years; and he died.
text_cn: 拉默客共活了七百七十七岁死了。

text_en: After Noah was five hundred years old, Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
text_cn: 诺厄五百岁时，生了闪、含和耶斐特。
